System software is software that directly operates the computer hardware and provides the basic functionality to the users as well as to the other software to operate smoothly.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: System software basically controls a computer’s internal functioning and also controls hardware devices such as monitors, printers, and storage devices.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: It is like an interface between hardware and user applications, helping them to communicate with each other.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Hardware understands machine language (i.e. 1 or 0) whereas user applications work in human-readable languages like English, Hindi, German, etc.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Closer to the computer system.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Written in a low-level language in general.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Difficult to design and understand.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Fast in speed (working speed).

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Less interactive for the users in comparison to application software.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: The main program of a computer system that manages all resources and provides an interface for user interaction.
Converts human-readable language into machine language and vice versa, processing programs written in high-level programming languages.
A program that controls a device and helps it perform its functions, enabling the operating system to communicate with external hardware.
Application software used to support computer infrastructure, which analyzes, configures, optimizes, and maintains the computer system.
Software that performs special functions or provides functions that are much more than the basic operation of the computer is known as application software.
